meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Haan — Indian skin tones ke liye **white-cast-free sunscreen** choose karna ho, toh meri top picks ye hain:

### [Minimalist SPF 50 Sunscreen]()
*₹224*

### [Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun Rice + Probiotics]()
*₹758*

### [Minimalist Light Fluid SPF 50 Face Sunscreen]()
*₹224*

### [Reequil Ultra Matte Dry Touch Sunscreen]()
*₹150*

### 🥇 Best overall: Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++
Meri **first recommendation**. Isme SPF 50, PA++++ hai aur brand specifically invisible/no-white-cast finish claim karta hai. Lightweight moisturiser jaisa feel hota hai, fragrance-free bhi hai. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/spf/products/multi-vitamin-spf-50?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** normal, combination, acne-prone skin + daily use  
**Approx:** ₹359–399

### 🥈 Premium option: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun
Agar budget thoda zyada hai aur **dewy/glowy finish** pasand hai, ye excellent option hai. Indian-skin recommendations mein bhi iska no-white-cast/lightweight finish highlight hua hai. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/korean-vs-indian-sunscreen-what-works-best-for-indian-skin-and-weather-101778478594042-amp.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** normal/dry skin  
**Avoid if:** bahut oily skin hai aur matte finish chahiye.

### 🥉 Oily skin: Re'equil Ultra Matte
Agar aapko sunscreen lagane ke baad **chipchipa/oily look bilkul nahi chahiye**, Ultra Matte better choice hai. Indian sunscreen recommendations mein ise no-white-cast aur sweat/water-resistant option ke roop mein list kiya gaya hai. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/these-7-sunscreens-without-white-cast-work-for-indian-skin-and-summers-101783583467308.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Meri simple choice:**  
- **Budget + all-rounder → Minimalist SPF 50**
- **Dry/dewy skin → Beauty of Joseon**
- **Oily/sweaty skin → Re'equil Ultra Matte**

Aap mujhe bas **apni skin type (oily/dry/combination) aur budget (₹300/₹500/₹1000)** bata do, main **sirf 1 best sunscreen** recommend kar dunga.
